description: This file contains platform-specific portability functions, including thread ID retrieval, sleep functions, call stack dumping, and demangling of symbol names, primarily for Linux, Windows, and Apple platforms. It also includes licensing information and external library references.

methods.name: inet_aton
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address from text to binary form, with platform-specific implementation for Windows.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds on Windows.

methods.name: mremap
methods.description: Stub function for memory remapping on Apple platforms.

methods.name: gettid
methods.description: Retrieves thread ID on Apple platforms.

methods.name: GetPCFromUContext
methods.description: Extracts program counter from ucontext_t structure for backtrace.

methods.name: OverrideStackTopWithPC
methods.description: Replaces top of stack with program counter for backtrace purposes.

methods.name: CallstackSignalHandler
methods.description: Signal handler to capture call stack in a specific thread.

methods.name: GetCallStack
methods.description: Retrieves call stack addresses for a thread, with platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: DumpCallStack
methods.description: Dumps call stack information into a list of callstack_info objects.

methods.name: SleepMs
methods.description: Sleeps for specified milliseconds on Linux.

methods.name: SleepUs
methods.description: Sleeps for specified microseconds on Linux.

methods.name: htonll
methods.description: Converts 64-bit integer host to network byte order, platform-specific.

methods.name: ntohll
methods.description: Converts 64-bit integer network to host byte order, platform-specific.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments.

methods.name: Demangled
methods.description: Demangles C++ symbol names for Linux and Windows.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns demangled class name from symbol.

methods.name: ClassNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts class name only from demangled symbol.
